title: Instant noodles
summary: Boiling water, a 3-minute timer, done: the easiest way to show off Remy's timers.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a simple demo. Checked by Matthew on 2026-11-07.
equipment: Plate or lid to cover the bowl
notes: Boiling water burns: pour slowly, away from you, and keep the bowl on a flat surface.
ingredients: 1 packet of instant noodles (with its flavour sachet)
Optional: a spring onion, sliced, or a soft-boiled egg

steps.instruction: Boil the kettle. Put the noodles in the bowl and sprinkle the flavour sachet over them.
looks_wrong: bowl not heatproof (thin plastic or glass that might crack)
steps.done_when: Noodles in the bowl and the kettle is boiling.

steps.instruction: Pour the boiling water over the noodles slowly, until they're just covered. Cover the bowl with a plate.
looks_wrong: bowl filled to the brim (hard to carry)
steps.done_when: The noodles are covered and the timer is running.

steps.instruction: When the timer ends, take the plate off carefully (steam!), stir with the fork to separate the noodles, and add any toppings.
looks_wrong: a hard block in the middle (cover for another minute)
face over the bowl when lifting the plate (steam burns)
